Subject: Finlytics POC - kickoff recap and next steps

Hi Alex / Sarah —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed plan so we’re aligned heading into the trial: 

Summary of outcomes from today’s discovery call:
- Success criteria confirmed: 1) 10%+ improvement in entity extraction accuracy vs baseline, 2) <150ms 95th-percentile token latency for interactive workflows, 3) end-to-end run in staging with your sample dataset (10k documents)
- Primary evaluation owners: Sarah (data & validation), Tim (infra), Alex (product sponsor)

Proposed POC plan and timeline (2-week focused trial):
1) Week 0 (this week): access + onboarding — we’ll need sample SFTP creds or cloud storage link, list of example prompts, and a short set of golden labels from Sarah (50 records)
2) Week 1: staging integration + run small batch (10k docs) — Marcus to provision a dedicated instance and help with data ingestion
3) Week 2: evaluation + metrics collection — Sarah to run validation and share scoring; we’ll iterate model config and batching settings
4) Wrap & next steps: review results and decide on Dedicated capacity / timeline for production

Owners / immediate asks: 
- Alex: confirm success criteria above (reply if anything missing)
- Sarah: share an initial sample (SFTP link or GCS/S3) and the 50 golden labels by Wed 2027-04-14
- Tim: confirm infra constraints / network IP allowlist (if we need to open firewall)
- Marcus: I’m looping you into infra tasks — can you target provisioning by Mon 2027-04-12?

Attachments: I’m attaching a 1-page POC plan and an initial success-criteria spreadsheet (see attached).

Next step: can we do a 15-min sync Tuesday to confirm access? I’ll set a calendar invite after I hear back on timing.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Success criteria: confirmed. One ask: include throughput target for bulk runs (we want to process the 10k batch within 2 hours as an objective).
- Data access: we will provide SFTP creds and a sample manifest. Sarah will drop the 50 golden labels by EOD Wed (2027-04-14).

Alex — thanks, great notes. See inline and plan updates below.

> One ask: include throughput target for bulk runs (we want to process the 10k batch within 2 hours as an objective).
Agree — I’ve added that to the success criteria doc. We’ll aim to hit <=2 hours for the 10k batch in staging; Marcus will tune batching and parallelism.

> Security/compliance: we require SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short data retention note for the trial.
We can share our SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA. For the trial, default logs/retention: 30 days of request logs, KV cache is ephemeral per-session and we do not store customer payloads beyond the trial unless customer opts-in. Monica — can you confirm and add a one-paragraph retention statement to the POC doc?

> Seats: we need two trial seats (Sarah + Tim) with admin access.
Done — Monica will provision two seats and invite Sarah & Tim by EOD Tue.

Updated owners & dates:
- Marcus Lin: infra provisioning + staging run — target: provision by 2027-04-14, first staging run 2027-04-18
- Monica Patel: user invites + SOC2/retention blurb — target: invites by 2027-04-13, SOC2 doc share by 2027-04-13
- Sarah Liu: share sample data + golden labels — target: 2027-04-14
- Marissa (me): coordinate and run weekly status sync — I’ll do Tue syncs at 11am PT, starting 2027-04-13 (tentative)

Attachments: I’ve updated the POC plan and success criteria (attached v1). Marcus / Monica — please review and flag any infra/ops concerns.

Thanks — will send a calendar invite for Tuesday 11am PT once I see confirmations.

—
Marissa
